The '''Talvarians''' were the inhabitants of the [[Talvaria system/Legends|Talvaria system]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Their [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] salesmen were known for their lack of scrupulosity.<ref name="SL">''[[Scoundrel's Luck]]''</ref>
